_comment: The feeds apps/telematics (hack/demo/tiles/telematics) will keep live dispatch supplied with: the customers' telematics providers and the weather alerts — all three fictional, like everything on the set, and shown by name only (no hostnames on camera). The tile is new on the set: seed.sh binds its egress interface through the egress approver, and the website's network still unbinds it to film an admin deciding. It makes no network calls; this list is only what its page shows. seed.sh copies it into the tile as feeds.json.

feeds.name: Fleetgrid
feeds.what: Van positions: Brightwell, Kettle Creek, Bluestem

feeds.name: Galewatch
feeds.what: Severe-weather alerts for the depots' counties
